prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1433; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism. The reported injury is plausible given the mechanics of this crash. Over the course of 30 visits, care included passive modalities, range-of-motion exercises, and a progressive home exercise program, following a usual and expected course of treatment. Visit frequency tapered as symptoms improved and the patient regained functional range of motion. Examination revealed cervical paraspinal tenderness and reduced range of motion that support the reported injury, while neurological screening and certain orthopedic tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or upper back is known to this provider. Billing review is ongoing for two similar charges recorded on the same date of service, which are being verified before final processing. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
